listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference to prior work on the Swedish pulp and paper industry for EnPI boundary levels — cited only, not the study's application context
listed_sector_signals.quote: The same boundary levels are adopted in the study by Andersson and Thollander on the Swedish pulp and paper industry [30]

listed_sector_signals.signal: Bibliographic reference to a pulp and paper KPI study
listed_sector_signals.quote: Andersson E, Thollander P. Key performance indicators for energy management in the Swedish pulp and paper industry. Energy Strategy Rev 2019;24:229–35.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Cited method developed for continuous production processes (EnPI aggregation), used conceptually here; not the paper's own setting
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
A recent study by Beisheim et al. [33] proposes a method that 
utilizes local EnPIs and an Energy Baseline (EnB) from the process level 
to the evaluation of a company or site.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Bibliographic reference explicitly naming continuous production processes
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Beisheim B, Kr¨amer S, Engell S. Hierarchical aggregation of energy performance 
indicators in continuous production processes. Appl Energy 2020;264:114709.

one_line: The paper develops and applies an energy end-use taxonomy, performance indicators, and a planning framework to the Swedish food industry (meat, beer, biscuit, dairy, fruit/vegetable, sauces, flour, pasta), which is batch/discrete food processing; Corpus-B sectors (pulp & paper, continuous production) appear only as cited references.
